visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Negative Numbers Look Even
visualizerParams.problemDescription: -3 is odd, but the program says it is even. Positive numbers are classified correctly.

solution.explanation: In C the remainder keeps the sign of the dividend, so -3 % 2 is -1, not 1. Comparing with == 1 misses every negative odd number. Testing n % 2 != 0 works for both signs.

tests.pattern:
(?<![\s\S])\s*7 is odd[ 	]*?
10 is even[ 	]*?
-3 is odd[ 	]*?
-8 is even[ 	]*?
0 is even\s*(?![\s\S])
